Located beside Uttara High School and College, this is a large and beautiful park. It is an ideal place to sit and breathe amidst nature. Note that it has specific visiting hours which may change from time to time.
The only cultural venue in Uttara. On various special occasions, concerts, street plays, and cultural programs are organized here.
